source_tables: Table 1 N-terminal sequence and length; Table 2 FAP half-life mean, SD and replicate count
assay: Purified recombinant human FAP, 0.2 micromolar, 37 C; MALDI-TOF parent-peptide time course
endpoint: Full-length parent peptide half-life in minutes; not an in-vivo half-life
inclusion: Nine numerical FAP half-lives of 11-42-residue hormones and neuropeptides with exposed N-terminal Ala or Pro; only the eight observed N-terminal triplets are accepted at inference
exclusions: Glucagon, oxyntomodulin, VIP and PACAP have censored non-50%-loss observations; chemokines are excluded. No zero rate is imputed.
